## Rediffmail Pro / Enterprise inbox

Webmail: https://webmail.rediffmailpro.com/

1. On **IMAP Email Trigger** create **IMAP** credentials:
   - User: **full email address** (not just the local part)
   - Password: mailbox password (enter in n8n only — never commit)
   - Host: `imap.rediffmailpro.com`
   - Port: `993`
   - SSL/TLS: **on**
2. If 993 fails, retry port `143` with SSL **off** (legacy Rediff setting).
3. Admin may need IMAP enabled: Admin → Other Services → Complete Mail Sync (set IMAP SYNC FROM date).
4. Set `sourceAccount` in **Set Source Account** to this inbox address.
5. Publish / activate. Existing Gmail workflows stay unchanged.

Docs: https://support.rediffmailpro.com/article/imap-configuration-for-ms-outlook-365/
